999008199.text:
ベップ、ヤンネさん、見て見て！　この間、師匠に
教えてもらって調合したの。どう？　かわいくない？

localizations.en: Bepp, Janne, look what I made! Master taught me how to synthesize this! Isn't it adorable?

999008199.text:
すっごくかわいい。さすが姉様。
成長がとどまるところを知らないわ

localizations.en: It's beautiful! You never cease to amaze me with your progress.

999008199.text:
あら素敵。アルビーナったら錬金術を
始めたばかりなのに、もうこんなものまで作れるのね

localizations.en: How lovely! And you've only just started learning alchemy. AlLeahdy making things like this...

999008199.text: 才能、ってやつですかねェ？　うふ

localizations.en: Must be natural talent, right? Hehe!

999008199.text:
そうだヤンネさん！
これ、かわいくできたからレアちゃんにどうぞ！

localizations.en: Oh, Janne! Here, this is for Leah! I made it extra cute just for her!

999008199.text:
この間、レアちゃんの姿見て驚いちゃった！
いつの間にかすっごく大きくなってるんだもん

localizations.en: I was so surprised when I saw her the other day! She's grown so much before I even noticed!

999008199.text:
子どもの成長ってとっても早いのよ。
私も毎日、あの子に驚かされているわ

localizations.en: Children grow up so fast. She surprises me every day.

999008199.text:
最近は近所のお友達と遊ぶのが楽しいみたいで……
お泊り会の約束をして帰ってきたりしてね

localizations.en: These days she's having such fun with her friends in the neighborhood... She even came home with plans for a sleepover.

999008199.text: 私と姉様は毎日お泊り会、フフフ

localizations.en: Every day is like a sleepover for us, hehe.

999008199.text:
そりゃあ、アタシとベップは家族だもん。
喜んじゃって、かわいい妹よの～

localizations.en: Well of course! We're family after all. You're just the cutest little sister ever~

999008199.text:
ところで、娘ちゃんたちのお泊り会って何するの？
ヤンネさん忙しいから大変じゃない？　アタシ手伝うよ

localizations.en: By the way, what do the girls do at these sleepovers? Must be tough with how busy you are, Janne. Want me to help?

999008199.text:
ありがとう、でも大丈夫よ。お友達のご両親が色々と
準備してくれてて……私は娘の送り迎えくらいなの

localizations.en: Thanks, but I'll be fine. The other parents are handling everything... I just need to drop her off and pick her up.

999008199.text:
それじゃあ、レアちゃんがお泊り会の間、
ヤンネさんは家に一人？

localizations.en: So you'll be all alone while Leah's at the sleepover?

999008199.text:
ええ。明後日から二泊三日。一人になるの久しぶり。
あの子の成長を感じられて嬉しいけれど、少し寂しいわ

localizations.en: Yes, two nights starting the day after tomorrow. It's been a while since I've had the house to myself. I'm happy to see her growing up, but it does feel a bit lonely.

999008199.text:
そ！　れ、な、ら！
アタシたちもお泊り会しようよ、ジムロック家で！

localizations.en: Then! It's! Decided! Let's have our own sleepover at our place!

999008199.text: ねっ、ベップ！
素晴らしい提案だわ、姉様

誘ってもらえるのは嬉しいけれど、
結婚して子どももいる私が、お泊り会だなんて――

localizations.en: I'm flattered, but a married woman with a child having a sleepover? That's a bit—

999008199.text: だからこそっすわ！

localizations.en: That's exactly why we should do it!

999008199.text: え？
子は親の背中を見て育つ、って言うでしょ？

localizations.en: You know how they say children learn by watching their parents?

999008199.text:
ヤンネさんが友達……アタシたちとの時間を大切にする
姿を見て、レアちゃんも友達を大切にする子に育つの！

localizations.en: If Leah sees you cherishing time with your friends—with us—she'll learn to value her own friendships too!

999008199.text: えぇ……一理あるわね

localizations.en: Well... you do have a point.

999008199.text:
それに、レアちゃんお泊り会第２弾をヤンネさんの家で
やるかもだし！　予習にちょうどいいんじゃ！？

localizations.en: Plus, Leah might want to have her next sleepover at your place! This'll be like a practice run!

999008199.text: 確かに……そうね

でも、突然お邪魔したら
ジムロックさんたちも困っちゃうわよ

localizations.en: But wouldn't we be imposing on your parents if we just showed up?

999008199.text:
むしろ、聖戦士で日々お疲れのヤンネさんを
おもてなしさせていただけないなんて……心が苦しい！

localizations.en: If anything, it would pain me to deny hospitality to a Sacred Knight who works so hard every day!

999008199.text: ほら、ベップも泊まってほしそうにこっちを見てるよ！

localizations.en: Look, even Bepp's giving you those puppy-dog eyes!

999008199.text: じー……

あら、本当だわ。
……じゃあ、お泊り会、お邪魔しちゃおうかしら

localizations.en: Oh my, you're right. Well... I suppose I could join this little sleepover after all.

999008199.text:
ほいきた！　アタシお母さんたちに言ってくる！
ベップは喜びのポーズをしてて

localizations.en: Score! I'll go tell Mom and Dad! Bepp, strike a victory pose!

999008199.text:
走るとケガするわよ！　……もう、アルビーナったら。
昔からこういうときばかり行動が速いんだから

localizations.en: Don't run, you'll hurt yourself! ...Oh, that Alvina. She's always been quick to act in times like these.

999008199.text:
まさに風の如く……素晴らしい行動力だわ、姉様。
私も見習わないと

localizations.en: Swift as the wind... Your decisiveness is truly inspiring. I should learn from your example.

999008199.text:
ただいまー！　お母さんもお父さんもオッケーだって！
明後日の仕事終わりは、ジムロック家に集合ね！

localizations.en: I'm back! Mom and Dad said it's fine! We'll meet up at our place after work the day after tomorrow!

999008199.text: ふふ、なんだか楽しみになってきたわね

localizations.en: Hehe, I'm actually getting excited about this.

999008199.text: 胸のドキドキを感じるわ

姉様とヤンネさんとお泊り会……
ワクワクが押し寄せてくる

localizations.en: A sleepover with you and Janne... The anticipation is overwhelming.

999008199.text:
（ヤンネさんとのお泊り会、いつ以来かな？
　ヤンネさんが結婚する前だから……結構前だなぁ）

localizations.en: (When was the last time I had a sleepover with Janne? Must've been before she got married... that's quite a while ago.)

999008199.text:
（結婚前はたまにお泊りしてたけど……ヤンネさん、
　お母さんになってから娘ちゃん第一になったしね）

localizations.en: (We used to have sleepovers now and then, but since she became a mother, Leah's always been her top priority.)

999008199.text: （久しぶりのお泊り会、楽しみだなぁ）

localizations.en: (I can't wait for this sleepover. It's been too long!)
